wiki.title: Cory McCray
wiki.extract: Cory V. McCray (born October 31, 1982) is an American politician and electrician who serves as a member of the Maryland Senate for Maryland's 45th district, located in northeast Baltimore City. Previously, McCray served as a member of the Maryland House of Delegates and acting Chair of the Maryland Democratic Party.
